atlases.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production art for Stone & Cold Tinkering motion comic. References: image1 is PRIMARY style and character identity, image2 additional character continuity only. Create a SINGLE high-detail SQUARE comic atlas, ideally 2048x2048, EXACTLY TWO equal columns and THREE equal rows, six rectangular scenes in reading order left-to-right top-to-bottom. Straight black grid lines at x=50%, y=33.333% and66.667%, no gutters, each cell edge-to-edge illustration, camera framed so heads fit. NO TEXT, lettering, speech balloons, labels, symbols or watermarks anywhere. Match primary reference's bold rough black ink outlines, angular hatching, deep shadows, old printed fantasy comic ochre and slate, cream highlights. NOT glossy 3D, not soft painterly. Characters fixed: Krek enormous warm brown cracked STONE Cragheart with blue eyes and bronze/leather harness, not a human armor knight; Nicola tiny tan Quatryl inventor, round blue goggles, bronze aviator helmet, red scarf brown clothes; Nyra tall elegant Orchid woman, long lilac hair, pointed ears, dark purple gown with gold trim, proud expressive profile. No extra party members. Hail when present: translucent mature female Aesther researcher with long pale hair tied back, simple slate robe, alive and physically present. All underground spaces must be CRAMPED and CLAUSTROPHOBIC, low ancient rough stonework almost touching Krek's shoulders/head, walls close, tiny light pools, no cathedral halls, no spacious battle arena. Each cell a different clear beat. Cell1: exterior of the dilapidated Crooked Bone tavern at cold dusk, no signage/letters, close narrow street. Cell2: interior cramped cluttered former tavern library, rickety shelves books ladder, Hail descending ladder, three heroes at door, Nicola visible near left-middle. Cell3: close Hail at cluttered desk with blank parchment showing only a simple circle sketch, gestures trio toward task, no real magic orb yet. Cell4: trio small trekking through snowy Copperneck Mountains toward a narrow dark old STONE tunnel, no buildings. Cell5: mountain wall metal sealed console door, four crystals: round red left, triangle blue top, orange polygon right, GREEN DIAMOND bottom and separate SMALL ROUND central button, no lettering; trio looking, nobody touching. Cell6: closeup of SAME intact console filling frame, green diamond now luminous, left-right crystals correctly placed, faint strange green energy around metal edges, nobody touching. No explosion; console will disappear later via motion comic effect.

stashAfter: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference is the arrival comic atlas. The Emergency Temporal Stash has VANISHED. Remove all metal door, machinery, crystals, green light, circles and buttons; replace them with uninterrupted ordinary rough natural rock cliff face with little winter frost. No doorway or cave entrance remains, no runes, no smoke, no people, no objects, no lettering, no panels/grid.
